subject: MSstatsPTM PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat - column(s) not found: Start

messages.author: 80b8cd33a1af37a0
messages.subject: MSstatsPTM PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat - column(s) not found: Start
parts:
I'm using MsStatsPTM version 2.2.4 and have come across this error

Using this R command:

# read ptm PSM and annot
raw_ptm = read.csv('phospho_PSMs.txt', sep='\t')
# read annotation
raw_annot = read.csv('ptm_annot.csv')

# load global PSM file and annot
protein_psm = read.csv('global_PSMs.txt', sep='\t')
protein_annot = read.csv('global_annot.csv')

# run mssstats input converter
ptm_input = PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat(
  input=raw_ptm,
  annotation=raw_annot,
  fasta_path='HomoSapiens_SwissProt_220629.fasta',
  protein_input=protein_psm,
  annotation_protein=protein_annot,
  labeling_type='TMT',
  which_proteinid='Master.Protein.Accessions')

Error message:

INFO: Extracting modifications
[1] "FASTA file missing 7864 Proteins. These will be removed. This may be due to non-unique identifications."
Error in `[.data.table`(data, , c(protein_name_col, unmod_pep_col, mod_pep_col,  :
  column(s) not found: Start

Traceback:
6: stop("column(s) not found: ", paste(ansvars[is.na(ansvals)],
       collapse = ", "))
5: `[.data.table`(data, , c(protein_name_col, unmod_pep_col, mod_pep_col,
       "Start"), with = FALSE)
4: data[, c(protein_name_col, unmod_pep_col, mod_pep_col, "Start"),
       with = FALSE]
3: .joinFasta(id_data, fasta_file, fasta_protein_name, protein_name_col,
       unmod_pep_col, mod_pep_col)
2: MSstatsPTMSiteLocator(input, protein_name_col = which_proteinid,
       unmod_pep_col = "Sequence", mod_pep_col = "ModSequence",
       clean_mod = FALSE, fasta_file = fasta_path, fasta_protein_name = fasta_protein_name,
       mod_id = "\\*", localization_scores = FALSE, localization_cutoff = localization_cutoff,
       remove_unlocalized_peptides = remove_unlocalized_peptides,
       terminus_included = FALSE, terminus_id = "\\.")
1: PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat(raw_ptm, raw_annot, "HomoSapiens_SwissProt_220629.fasta",
       protein_psm, protein_annot, labeling_type = "TMT", which_proteinid = "Master.Protein.Accessions",
       use_log_file = FALSE)

The error seems to come from .joinFasta() function in utils_converts.R 
## Locate peptide sequence start data$Start = mapply(function(x,y){unlist(gregexpr(pattern=x, y))[[1]]}, data[, unmod_pep_col, with=FALSE][[1]], data[, "sequence"][[1]]) data$Start = unlist(data$Start) data = data[, c(protein_name_col, unmod_pep_col, mod_pep_col, "Start"), with=FALSE]



This is bizarre because I've ran other PSMs in the exact same configurations without this error.. 
Any ideas on how to debug this?

Thank you,
Kibeom

messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat - column(s) not found: Start
parts:
I used the source code to replicate my error - it seems that this happens because there is no match between the PD PSM file's sequence and the uniprot sequence. (Which our team should sort out) 

This results in the following script to give an empty table, which leads to the error. 

data = data[!is.na(data$sequence),]

I'm not sure how frequent you'd run across this problem, but perhaps a more specific error message could be helpful. 

Thanks

From my understanding, the peptide sequence from PD should match what is found in the FASTA file you use for search/index in PD.  I would suggest contacting developers at PD to understand when a sequence from PD may not match what's found in the FASTA file (maybe it happens when you're dealing with variants?  Or it's a PD software bug?  I'm not sure honestly).
